glance.headline: FCC Signs Off on SpaceX Satellite Plan
glance.teaser: SpaceX satellite plan gets FCC approval
glance.summary: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites into space for its "Starmind" initiative. This is the agency's first approval for AI data centers in space.

glance.headline: AI Chatbot Toys Banned in New York
glance.summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years. Common Sense Media research revealed troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
glance.why: Families cannot buy AI chatbot toys in New York because of safety failures and development risks.

glance.headline: State AGs Challenge Character.AI Private Chats Auction
glance.summary: State AGs are challenging Character.ai's proposed bankruptcy sale. The auction of users' private chats includes sensitive personal data from over 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors.
OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter for ChatGPT as it combines Chat and Work.

office_blend.headline: Physical AI Value at Atlanta Airport
office_blend.summary: Chris Crist, chief information officer at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, showed how physical AI could find someone across seven thousand camera feeds, like a person who dropped a bag and ran.

office_blend.headline: Ally Financial Reinvents Customer Personas With Agentic AI
office_blend.summary: At Ally Financial, UX designers and content teams use agentic AI to reinvent customer personas. This helps tailor digital experiences and anticipate how customers will respond to new offerings.

still_roasting.summary: Nothing revealed its upcoming Ear Note AI earbuds and microphone-equipped recording charging case ahead of their December 8th release.
Tidal will ban AI-generated music on December 9th, deleting roughly 29 million songs and rejecting tens of thousands of submissions daily.
Amazon Bedrock launched a public preview of its Trusted Access API featuring Anthropic controls for Claude Fable models.

quick_sips.summary: S&P may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA- over corporate governance and "key man" risks.
OpenAI warned heavy ChatGPT users they may hit limits sooner as it combines its Chat and Work experiences.
Amazon held discussions about allowing Meta's Muse AI agent to shop directly on its marketplace.

stories.label: Code review
stories.headline: Claude Ship Lets Claude Approve Routine Pull Requests
stories.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Ship, a set of three agents that can review pull requests, fix them, and approve routine pull requests.

concept.explanation: Zero data retention (ZDR) is a feature in Vercel's AI Gateway where developers require AI providers to prove they do not keep submitted prompts.

long_read.headline: How Anthropic builds software in 2026 with Katelyn Lesse
long_read.summary: The newsletter covers an explanation by Katelyn Lesse on how Anthropic rewrote Claude's API in Rust and how AI agents are changing engineering at the company.
